places.name: Kuriya (soba house)
places.address: 219 E 85th St (btwn 2nd & 3rd Ave), New York, NY 10028
buy: Hot soba in dashi broth (kake soba)
Soba set, ask for hot broth
places.avoid: Skip the dipping-soba sets topped with raw fish, wasabi and tempura.
places.notes: Opened Sept 6, 2026; tiny spot (one table plus bar) from the Suki Desu team. Phone (646) 596-8343. Menu leans toward dipping soba and raw-seafood toppings, so ask specifically for hot broth. No official hours found; the hours above are an estimate - call before going.

places.name: Tenzan 89
places.address: 1714 2nd Ave (at E 89th St), New York, NY 10128
places.avoid: Skip spicy rolls, tempura and iced drinks.
places.notes: Phone (212) 369-3600. Yelp listing updated Oct 2026 shows 12:00-22:00; older OpenTable data says 11:00-23:00. One Yelp comment claims the location is no longer owned by the Tenzan group though the sign still reads Tenzan 89 - call ahead.

places.name: Tri Dim Shanghai
places.address: 1378 3rd Ave (btwn E 78th & 79th St), New York, NY 10075
buy: Steamed pork soup dumplings (xiao long bao)
places.avoid: Skip the Szechuan dishes, chili chicken dumplings and anything fried.
places.notes: Phone (212) 585-3388. Time Out lists Mon-Fri 11:30-21:45 and weekends 12:00-21:45; other directories say 22:00 close. Shanghainese menu with a Szechuan section; ask for no chili and light oil.

places.name: Tang by Mr Sun
places.address: 1442 3rd Ave (btwn E 81st & 82nd St), New York, NY 10028
places.avoid: Skip black pepper beef, Peking duck skin and other rich, oily plates.
places.notes: Takeout line (646) 590-2910. Upscale Cantonese, $31-50 per person, reservations recommended. OpenTable shows Sat-Sun until 23:30; another source has Sunday closing at 22:30. Congee is not a regular menu item; steamed fish and soups are.

places.name: Yamadaya Japanese Grocery (UES)
places.address: 1279 3rd Ave (at E 74th St), New York, NY 10021
places.avoid: Skip spicy snacks, carbonated drinks and the cold-case iced drinks.
places.notes: New UES branch at the corner of 74th & 3rd, soft-opened late summer 2026. No hours published for this store; the hours above are the chain's other Manhattan stores (5th Ave, 6th Ave) at 10:30-21:30 - confirm before going.

places.name: Pastrami Queen
places.address: 1125 Lexington Ave #2 (at E 78th St), New York, NY 10075
places.avoid: Skip the pastrami and corned beef sandwiches and the pickles.
places.notes: Official site lists 10:00-21:00 daily. Phone (212) 734-1500. Certified kosher. No reservations; expect lines at weekend lunch.

places.name: Tal Bagels (E 86th St)
places.address: 333 E 86th St (btwn 1st & 2nd Ave), New York, NY 10028
places.avoid: Skip onion/garlic bagels, smoked fish and the coffee.
places.notes: Phone (212) 427-6811. Hours conflict across sources: 06:00-20:00, 06:00-18:00, and Sunday 06:00-15:00; the most common version is used above. A Sept 2025 health inspection confirms it was operating.

places.name: H&H Bagels (Upper East Side)
places.address: 1551 2nd Ave (at E 81st St), New York, NY 10075
places.avoid: Skip onion bagels, cured fish and sweetened coffee drinks.
places.notes: Official site lists 06:00-16:00 daily - closes at 4 pm. Phone (212) 734-7441. H&H's oldest operating location.

places.name: 3 Guys Restaurant
places.address: 960 Madison Ave (btwn E 75th & 76th St), New York, NY 10021
places.avoid: Skip burgers and fries, Greek salad and iced coffee.
places.notes: Official site says 07:00-21:00 daily; Yelp and the Madison Ave BID directory say 08:00-20:00, so there is a conflict. Phone (212) 628-8108. About seven blocks south of the Met; pricey for a diner.

places.name: Nectar (Madison Ave diner)
places.address: 1090 Madison Ave (at E 82nd St), New York, NY 10028
places.avoid: Skip fried breakfasts, ketchup-heavy plates and lemony Greek dishes.
places.notes: Corner diner open since 1988, one block from the Met. Phone (212) 772-0916. A March 2026 health inspection record confirms it is operating; hours are from a third-party directory.

places.name: Eli's Market (Eli Zabar)
places.address: 1411 3rd Ave (NE corner of E 80th St), New York, NY 10028
places.avoid: Skip the smoked fish, pickled items and citrus-dressed salads.
places.notes: Official site lists 07:00-19:30 daily, phone (212) 717-8100, but the page may be a few years old. Very expensive (one reviewer cited $38 for a pint of matzo ball soup). Sister cafe E.A.T. (1064 Madison, near the Met) also has chicken soup but its hours could not be confirmed.

places.name: Whole Foods Market (Upper East Side)
places.address: 1551 3rd Ave (btwn E 87th & 88th St), New York, NY 10128
buy: Hot bar steamed vegetables and rice
places.avoid: Skip the spicy and fried hot-bar items and the cold-pressed juices.
places.notes: Official site lists 07:00-22:00 daily, phone (646) 891-3888. Soup bar and hot food bar make it one of the most reliable evening sources of warm food in the area.

places.name: Gracie's on 2nd Diner
places.address: 1633 2nd Ave (at E 85th St), New York, NY 10028
buy: Roast chicken with plain rice (no gravy)
places.avoid: Skip fried items, tomato-sauce dishes and sodas.
places.notes: Phone (212) 879-9425. Multiple directories list it as 24 hours; one Slice listing shows a midnight close, so call before a late-night trip. One of the few all-night diners on the UES.

places.name: CVS Pharmacy (305 E 86th St, 24h)
places.address: 305 E 86th St (btwn 1st & 2nd Ave), New York, NY 10028
places.avoid: Skip mint-flavored lozenges, caffeinated drinks and sparkling water.
places.notes: Store open 24 hours; pharmacy counter closes around 21:00 (lunch break 13:30-14:00). Phone (212) 722-2003. Other pharmacies near the 86th/Lex hub: CVS 150 E 86th (Mon-Fri 09:00-19:00, Sat-Sun 10:00-17:00) and Duane Reade 1235 Lexington (roughly 08:00/09:00-20:00/21:00); neither is 24h.
